title: Raspberry Pi Prices and Lifecycle 2012-2026
subtitle: Official USD list prices since 2012 and lifecycle dates of 45 products
sources: Raspberry Pi Ltd only: news posts on raspberrypi.com (dated by article:published_time), product pages, product briefs and obsolescence notices on pip.raspberrypi.com, archived official product pages (Internet Archive). Inflation: US CPI-U, BLS series CUUR0000SA0. Every row links its own source. Method: https://github.com/raspberry-tips/rpi-prices-lifecycle

resources.description: Official US list prices (USD, excluding tax and shipping): one row per product, date and memory variant, covering launches, increases, cuts and current list prices since 2012.

fields.name: product_id
fields.description: Stable product key, matches lifecycle.csv.

fields.name: product
fields.description: Product name as used by Raspberry Pi.

fields.name: family
fields.description: Product family: boards, zero, compute (Compute Modules) or pico.

fields.name: date
fields.description: Date the price took effect or was announced (YYYY-MM-DD).

fields.name: variant
fields.description: Memory/storage variant, e.g. 4GB or 8GB/32GB eMMC; empty if the product has only one.

fields.name: sku
fields.description: Raspberry Pi SKU where the source names one.

fields.name: usd
fields.description: List price in USD after this event; empty for change-only rows (basis delta_only).

fields.name: delta_usd
fields.description: Price change in USD against the previous price of this variant (negative = cut).

fields.name: event
fields.description: launch, increase, cut, current_list (price confirmed by a current product page or brief), unchanged, announcement, revision or variant_withdrawn.

fields.name: basis
fields.description: How the price was obtained: stated (verbatim in the source), calculated (previous price plus a stated increase), assumption (increase not stated for this product), approximate, or delta_only (only the change is documented).

fields.name: basis_detail
fields.description: Finer version of basis, e.g. derived_confirmed when a calculated price later appears verbatim in another source.

fields.name: confirmed
fields.description: For calculated prices: true if the result also appears verbatim in a later source. Empty where not applicable.

fields.name: verified
fields.description: false marks rows whose value is not directly backed by the cited source (assumptions or inconsistent statements); the note explains why.

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: Primary source on raspberrypi.com or pip.raspberrypi.com.

fields.name: source_published
fields.description: Publication time of the source (article:published_time) where available.

fields.name: note
fields.description: Explanation, e.g. for assumptions and conflicts between official sources.

resources.description: Production guarantees and end-of-life data for 45 Raspberry Pi products, one row per product.

fields.name: product_id
fields.description: Stable product key, matches prices.csv.

fields.name: product
fields.description: Product name.

fields.name: family
fields.description: boards, zero, compute, pico or accessories.

fields.name: launch_date
fields.description: Launch or sales start (YYYY-MM-DD).

fields.name: production_until
fields.description: Month of the official 'will remain in production until at least' statement (YYYY-MM). A minimum, not an end date.

fields.name: status
fields.description: active, active_no_date (no end date published), guarantee_passed, end_of_life (formal notice), not_offered or discontinued.

fields.name: eol_date
fields.description: End-of-life date from an official obsolescence notice.

fields.name: last_time_buy
fields.description: Last-time-buy date from the obsolescence notice.

fields.name: last_time_ship
fields.description: Last-time-ship date from the obsolescence notice.

fields.name: verified_primary
fields.description: true if the lifecycle data is backed by a primary Raspberry Pi source; false if none was found (see note).

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: Primary source of the lifecycle data.

fields.name: checked
fields.description: Date the source was last checked.

fields.name: note
fields.description: Explanation, e.g. conflicting dates between official sources.

resources.description: Complete dataset: everything in both CSV files plus price events, the history of extended production guarantees, EOL notices, documented conflicts between official sources, value definitions and the CPI series used for inflation adjustment.
